title: Kumdan kale

characters.WOMAN: a young woman with a short black bob, wearing a blue and white striped t-shirt and rolled-up jeans, barefoot

scenes.text:
Dalga gelir,
kumdan kaleni alıp götürür.
scenes.prompt: On a sandy beach on a late summer evening, a gentle wave washes over a sandcastle while {WOMAN} kneels beside it with surprised eyes, soft orange sunset light.

scenes.text: Bir süre öylece bakarsın boş kıyıya.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} sits on the wet sand hugging her knees, looking at the smooth empty shore where the castle was, calm sea, pink evening sky.
Close view of the hands of {WOMAN} scooping wet sand with a small red bucket beside her, seashells around, warm golden light.

scenes.text: Bu sefer biraz daha yukarıya kurarsın.
scenes.prompt: Higher up on the dry beach, {WOMAN} smiles while shaping the towers of a new bigger sandcastle, waves far behind her, sunset glow.

scenes.text: Kale gitti ama onu kuran eller hâlâ sende.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} stands proudly next to her finished sandcastle with sandy hands, the first stars appearing over the calm sea, seagulls in the purple sky.

caption:
Bazen her şey baştan başlar. Ve sen yine kurarsın. 🤍

Yeniden başlamaya çalışan birine gönder.
